note: Goal statements and targets are AUTHORED — a commitment cannot be derived. Every current value is MEASURED by hq/server.py's evaluator. A goal nothing can measure says so and counts against this pillar's assurance fraction.

verdict_template.unassured: Nothing is failing; monitoring is still landing on {unassured} of {total} areas, and the plans are filed.
verdict_template.ok: Green on main, and the test runs are recent enough to believe.

goals.statement: The test suite passes almost every time — failures are incidents, not a slow leak.
goals.statement_short: the test suite fails often enough to look like a leak rather than an incident
goals.why_it_matters: Three failures in one afternoon is a bad day. Three spread over a month is a test nobody trusts.

path_to_green.narrative: Read the failure ticks on the strip — where they cluster says whether this is one incident or a leak.

goals.statement: The rules that keep replays reproducible still hold in the code.
goals.statement_short: a rule that keeps replays reproducible is broken in the code
goals.why_it_matters: Recorded sessions are the training data phase 4 runs on. A break here is silent until bot training fails, which is the worst possible time to find out.

members.label: no raw randomness outside the two sanctioned generators
the sim layer touches no node, autoload or input
one gateway for every world change

path_to_green.narrative: Run `python3 tools/check_gateway.py` — a broken rule names the line that broke it, and what the line should have done instead.

goals.statement: Recorded sessions can still be tied to the build that produced them.
goals.statement_short: most recorded sessions can no longer be tied to any build
goals.why_it_matters: A session whose build is unresolvable cannot be replayed or scored. It is evidence that has quietly stopped being evidence.

path_to_green.narrative: One fresh session on the tablet, from a build with nothing uncommitted in it, fixes this — the same sitting Product needs to show a first-time player finds the cot on their own.

goals.statement_short: Build fails either do to code/syntax errors or due to failures in the test suite.
goals.why_it_matters: A game that doesn't work can't be released.  Failed builds gate releasing.
